visuals.prompt: Design Systems Day 43 Part 2 Visual: Tokenized Input Architecture: Chip Arrays, Backspace Deletion Loops & Inline Filter Buffers

steps.label: Tokenized Chip Mounting
steps.caption: Selected entities render as discrete interactive chips alongside the text caret.

steps.label: Inline Buffer Synchronizing
steps.caption: The inline input buffer adjusts width dynamically as token chips wrap vertically.

steps.label: Pending Delete Highlighting
steps.caption: Initial backspace keypress highlights the preceding chip in an amber warning state.

steps.label: Defensive Chip Removal
steps.caption: Secondary backspace confirmation cleanly removes the token and announces deletion.

steps.label: Arrow Key Single Traversal
steps.caption: Arrow keys navigate option candidates with circular boundary wrapping mechanics.

steps.label: Page Key Chunk Navigation
steps.caption: Page up and page down keys advance the highlighted index in ten-item chunks.

steps.label: Boundary Extreme Jumping
steps.caption: Home and end keys trigger instantaneous jumping to the first and last options.

steps.label: Space Key Selection Toggling
steps.caption: The space key toggles candidate selection without closing the active dropdown popup.

steps.label: Viewport Capacity Computing
steps.caption: The virtualization engine calculates viewport capacity and total phantom scroll height.

steps.caption: The active rendering slice extracts only the visible items plus overscan buffers.

steps.caption: Explicit set size and position attributes preserve full screen reader dataset context.
